description: Lexpad's window, the whole web app: every API call through the core (which holds the session and checks each call), whether there is a session, connecting in the browser and signing out, a page of the web app in the browser, the desktop section of Settings (shortcut, reading the selection, quick-add notebook, start-up, notifications, where Lexpad opens), the reminder plan, the newest desktop versions on lexpad.app (read by the core), and what the Watch page and Settings → Video player need of the video player: whether there is one, Continue watching, which app opens each video type, the words waiting for sign-in, and opening the Player's window (which plays; this window does not). Nothing else: no file system, no shell, no window control.
